topics.topic: The Petty Cash Book and Imprest System
subtopics: Meaning and purpose of the Petty Cash Book in business administration
The Imprest System and float calculation
Ruling analytical columns: Stationery, transport, postage, tea/refreshments
objectives: Explain how the imprest system operates with a fixed cash float
Enter 8 petty expenses into analytical expense columns
Balance the Petty Cash Book and calculate the reimbursement voucher amount

topics.topic: Ledger Accounts and the Trial Balance
subtopics: The Ledger as the principal book of accounts
Classification of accounts: Real, personal, and nominal accounts
Extraction of the Trial Balance: Proving arithmetical equality of debits and credits
objectives: Classify 10 balance sheet items into real, personal, and nominal accounts
Post debit and credit balances into the General Ledger
Extract and balance a Trial Balance with matching totals in Naira

topics.topic: Office Procedures, Mail Handling and Filing Systems
subtopics: Incoming and outgoing mail handling: Date stamping, mail registers, dispatch book
Filing systems: Alphabetical, numerical, geographical, subject-matter filing
Filing equipment: Lateral filing cabinets, lever-arch files, microfilming, cloud storage
objectives: Outline step-by-step procedures for handling incoming executive correspondence
Compare alphabetical with numerical filing classifications
Explain 4 benefits of computerized electronic document archiving

subtopics: Meaning of entrepreneurship and traits of successful entrepreneurs
Forms of business ownership: Sole proprietorship, partnership
Business feasibility planning, startup capital, and registration with Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC)
objectives: Analyze advantages and liabilities of sole proprietorship in Nigeria
Draft a 1-page business plan outline for a school stationary kiosk
